segments.name: Online lending
segments.description: Operates an online consumer lending platform in China connecting individual borrowers with investors.
segments.evidence: The Group operates and manages its business as a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: The company charges fees for its loan facilitation services to borrowers and investors.
revenueModel.evidence: such as the determination of the fee rate at which the Company charges for its services and the allocation of budget between operating costs and expense

changes.text: By 2025 the company disposed of its overseas subsidiaries in Nigeria that had extended small credit loans to individual borrowers.
changes.evidence: As of the date of this annual report, we have disposed of our subsidiaries in Nigeria.
